title: Equistamp
subtitle: Research Engineer · Full-time
description: AI safety contractor, embedded with METR and Redwood Research.

positions.title: Research Engineer
bullets: Contributed to [[[Hawk]]] — now used by the UK AI Security Institute and EU AI Office.

Deployed and audited its full [[AWS infrastructure stack]]{EKS, ECS Fargate, Aurora, Pulumi IaC. Stood it up end-to-end on a fresh account, surfacing and fixing blockers across Kubernetes, networking, and the Hawk CLI, and documenting friction points for external adopters.}; upstream fixes unblocked external adoption.

Found and fixed multiple [[cross-tenant security issues]]{Spanning data integrity, IAM policy design, authorization, and concurrency — including a race condition I discovered in my own earlier security fix. Favored narrowly scoped, least-privilege changes over architectural rewrites.} with least-privilege fixes.

Diagnosed a [[CPU-starvation timeout storm]]{Reproduced the client-side failure mode experimentally on an evaluation run of ~297k model calls, then added runner metrics, Datadog alerts, and runbooks that catch it within minutes instead of in postmortem. Also contributed retry-cause telemetry upstream to inspect_ai, merged in 0.3.251, making retrying timeouts attributable as they happen.} and cut a [[hot Postgres query ~200×]]{~890 ms → ~4 ms by replacing a bitmap scan with a partial composite index, hardened against invalid concurrent-index states to preserve zero-downtime deployment.}.
Scored 50+ agent transcripts to build [[human baselines]]{Benchmarking human vs. LLM detection of covert side-task pursuit.} for METR's [[[monitorability]]] research.

positions.title: AI Control & SWE
bullets: Contributing to [[[LinuxArena]]], one of the largest [[[AI control]]] evaluation frameworks to date.

Engineered [[adversarial attack scenarios]]{eg. data exfiltration, backdooring, production sabotage. Designed containerized multi-service attack surfaces and automated tooling to generate and test variants at scale; contributed to a published benchmark dataset.} with high evasion rates against [[[frontier monitors]]] like Claude Opus and GPT-5.

Audited 10 AI research experiments for [[sabotage and evaluation-integrity failures]]{Triangulated 2,000–4,000+ code commits, execution logs, git history, and experimental artifacts per audit — including re-deriving reported metrics from raw per-sample data to catch grading bugs and metric-gaming. Produced evidence-based findings and remediation recommendations for issues affecting research validity.}, delivering a credence and code-cited fixes each.
Maintained [[[Control Tower]]] and redesigned its [[model cost-tracking abstraction]]{Significantly improved reliability and observability of per-model cost accounting across evaluation runs.}.

title: UW Graphics Group · Madison, WI
subtitle: Directed Study
bullets: Investigating representational limitations of visualization design guidelines for automated synthesis, building on baseline from [[[Choi et al.]]].
Built and analyzed a corpus of 1.5K+ guidelines across 49 sources to surface inconsistencies in existing frameworks.
Designed and evaluated an LLM-assisted pipeline to probe assumptions and scalability of guideline structuring.

Developed a [[7-dimension classification schema]]{Seven supplementary dimensions (A–G) capturing guideline properties the baseline template misses — covering things like risk/failure modes and audience dependency. Two dimensions have since been promoted to core status based on initial findings.} for systematic cross-source comparison; co-authoring a conference paper on the findings.

title: Meta · Menlo Park, CA
subtitle: AI/Data Science Intern
bullets: Designed and deployed an end-to-end production Machine Learning pipeline for unstructured text classification using [[[LLaMA]]] models, reducing misclassification by ~30% in deployment feedback analysis.

Built a scalable LLaMA-based [[agent framework]]{Supports multi-step task execution with memory and agent-chaining; refactored a large codebase into a compact, maintainable architecture.} for multi-step task execution.
Built a React analytics dashboard integrated with Meta's internal stack; defined data models and APIs that enabled 12+ teams to act on 100K+ weekly datapoints.

Led testing and QA efforts, resolving issues pre-release to improve performance and user experience.
